id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Source-synchronous parallel memory bus. Controller drives clock + command + address to one or more DDR3 SDRAM devices. DIMM modules use fly-by routing with end-of-line termination.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + DDR3 UDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Unbuffered DIMM; fly-by routing; Write Leveling required.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + DDR3 LRDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Load-Reduced DIMM with memory buffer chip.

supported_topologies.name: Stacked / dual-die / quad-die packages
supported_topologies.description: Multiple dies with CKE0/CKE1, CS0#..CS3#, ODT0/ODT1, ZQ0..ZQ3.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates CK and CKE; issues commands; tracks per-bank state.
Decodes commands; sources/sinks DQ; provides WL/ZQ feedback.
Re-drives CA/CTRL; adds +1 cycle CA latency.

fields.interconnect_role: No DDR3-protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). Flat 1-controller : N-rank bus. Rank via CS#; bank via BA; row/column via A.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_burst: 8 or 4 beats per MR0 RBT + column LSB.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Committed in issue order; no DRAM reordering.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Single linear DRAM array as 3D address space (bank × row × column).
default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Section 2 — DDR3 SDRAM Package Pinout and Addressing
